label: Regular-price women's and unisex fan tees at the WNBA Store
limits: One retailer (WNBA Store, run by Fanatics), one day, T-shirts only.
About 30 tees read from listing pages that held 72 of roughly 800 results; not a full assortment.
Regular prices are used. The store was running a 30%-off promotion that day, so shelf prices were lower.
Hoodies, jerseys and outerwear were not baselined, so a high top price on a jacket is not evidence of premium positioning.
